title: Testing read-only impersonation allowlist entries against mutating siblings
answers: Prevent read-only impersonation allowlist from permitting mutating sibling actions
Why does TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware require mutating sibling tests?
body:
When allowlisting a POST endpoint in posthog/middleware.py:READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS, the regex must specify the exact action rather than a broad resource prefix.
Enforced in posthog/test/test_middleware.py:TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware by pairing allowlist cases in test_read_only_impersonation_allows_allowlisted_post with mutating sibling checks in test_read_only_impersonation_blocks_mutating_siblings.
If mutating sibling test cases are omitted, accidental widening of the allowlist regex will silently expose write endpoints to read-only impersonation sessions.
applies: Adding and testing endpoints in READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS
